purpose: 统一采用用户选定标题，以十种不同视觉形式展示完整业务原理，供挑选 README 总览图。

adjustments.purpose: 校正图中分子、分母的简要定义。
adjustments.followup_prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram edit. Preserve this entire overhead photographic 微课堂 study-desk image exactly, including the main title, five workflow stages, all text, the corrected numerator/denominator definitions, arrows, paper textures and objects. Fix ONLY the small rectangle in the central notebook's “类比” section, directly above the label “2/4”. It currently appears to have THREE vertical compartments, which does not illustrate 2/4 correctly. Redraw that same rectangle at the same position and size with FOUR equal-width vertical compartments, using three evenly spaced internal vertical divider lines. Fill exactly the left TWO compartments with the existing salmon-pink color and leave exactly the right TWO compartments off-white. It must visually show one-half of the rectangle shaded, meaning 2 out of 4 equal parts. Keep the “2/4” label and the correct half-shaded circle labeled “1/2” unchanged. Make the comparison mathematically accurate. Do not modify anything else or add text. Full original landscape image, sharp Chinese typography.
adjustments.prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram edit. Preserve this entire photorealistic overhead study-desk 微课堂 illustration exactly, including the selected main title, all five steps, every arrow, the notebook, props, fraction exercises, labels, layout and style. Make TWO tiny factual wording corrections only in the central notebook's “图解” section. In the blue small concept box under “分数”, keep “分子” and change the parenthetical explanation from “（表示部分）” to the exact text “（所取份数）”. In the pink small concept box, keep “分母” and change its explanation from “（表示整体）” to the exact text “（等分份数）”. These precise definitions mean the numerator is the number of parts taken, and the denominator is the number of equal parts making one whole. Keep both parenthetical explanations clearly readable inside their existing boxes. No other visual or text changes. Do not alter the 1/2 and 2/4 comparison or the practice questions. Preserve the landscape frame and sharp Chinese typography.

images.name: 地铁线路图
images.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Create ONE finished landscape illustration for the Chinese README of the personal learning app 微课堂. Approximately 16:9, high-resolution, designed to remain clear at 1000px wide. This is one of ten alternative visual forms: follow the specified art direction closely and make the medium and composition distinctive. It must be a complete, expressive explanation of the full learning process, not just a picture of a learning object.
EXACT PROMINENT TITLE, in accurate simplified Chinese, with no missing words: “微课堂：每天 10 分钟，搭建属于你的认知地图”. The title may use two well-balanced lines: “微课堂：每天 10 分钟，” then “搭建属于你的认知地图”. Keep the title separate from the diagram, large and easy to read.
There are FIVE stages, connected explicitly in this order, without bypasses: 01→02→03→04→05.
Exact stage headings, each appears once:
“01 学习目标”
“02 拆分小知识点”
“03 每天 10 分钟微课堂”
“04 定时复习”
“05 形成认知地图”
Supporting copy:
Stage 1: “明确想学会什么”. Show a meaningful learning goal turning into an actionable starting point.
Stage 2: “把大目标拆成小步”. Show one topic breaking into several small knowledge units; optional unit labels “知识点 A”, “知识点 B”, “知识点 C”.
Stage 3 is the main focal region and should have about one-third of the content area. Prominently show a clock reading “10 分钟”, and SIX visually distinct learning activities with large exact labels “讲解”, “图解”, “类比”, “练习”, “反馈”, “追问”. Illustrate their differences through explanatory text/book, relationship diagram, comparison, written exercise, response/checking, and question/conversation. This part must be rich and readable, not six tiny decorations.
Stage 4: “按掌握情况调整间隔”. Represent recurring review with calendar/cards or a medium-appropriate recurrence motif, no numerical dates or invented interval values. Draw a secondary clear return arrow 04→03, while preserving the primary forward arrow 04→05.
Stage 5: “建立知识联系”. Represent a personal cognitive map as meaningful connected knowledge units with three readable status labels “已掌握”, “待巩固”, “下一步”. It is a conceptual map, not an actual interface screenshot. Knowledge connections emerge through the learner's understanding and practice.
Small footer: “业务原理示意”.
Communication: the user understands a whole goal is decomposed and learned gradually across multiple daily sessions; ten minutes is the session duration, not a promise of instant mastery. Learning and review repeatedly improve and connect knowledge. Make the five-step path unambiguous, no arrows directly skipping stage 2, no backward main progression, no duplicate numbering. Use large beautifully typeset Chinese; avoid small unreadable filler. No new features such as videos, podcasts, audio playback, streaks, rewards, leaderboard, login, app screenshots or programming architecture. No claims of guaranteed learning outcomes. Do not add alternative titles or marketing slogans. Good margins, nothing cropped.

Art direction:
VISUAL FORM: a professionally designed transit network diagram, crisp flat vector-like editorial design on warm white, near-black type, dark teal main line, amber review loop, coral and sage supporting stations. No perspective, no 3D, no paper notebook, no miniature scenery.
COMPOSITION: a large clear route map with five numbered interchange stations connected by a thick geometric line with rounded bends. Stage 1 upper-left, stage 2 lower-left, stage 3 large central interchange, stage 4 upper-right, stage 5 far-right/lower-right connected constellation. Connect ONLY in correct 1→2→3→4→5 order with obvious arrow direction. Stage 2 has a small branching feeder of knowledge units. The central 10-minute interchange branches into six short spokes ending in substantial pictograms and exact learning-form names, with enough space for each. The review return line is visibly a secondary amber route from 4 to 3, not another forward stage. The cognitive-map endpoint evolves into a meaningful network of learned and upcoming stops. The map aesthetic itself must communicate how learning units connect. Legibility, whitespace, line routing, and typographic hierarchy like an excellent museum wayfinding map; visually rich because the route tells the business story, not because of decorative objects.
images.review: 候选稿：第二步到第三步的箭头方向未修正，未用于 README。
